about.what: paired differences of the registered read-outs H2 and H3 on every log of E3 (Qwen2.5-VL-3B), method of e3_qwen/code/e3_analyze.py (endpoints)
about.statistic: fx.stats.crossed_bootstrap_diff over calibration draws x edits, 2000 resamples, seed 0, 95 percent percentile interval; p = two-sided bootstrap value (share of resamples on the other side of 0, doubled; resolution 0.0005: a value at the resolution is an upper bound)
about.H2: rephrase exact (T-Gen + I-Gen) / 2 of rescope minus the reference, on all edits, on the first 100 edits and on later edits only (R8: stream position >= 500); gate_coverage_form_20_draws: the same difference of the coverage of text and image rephrases over the 20 calibration draws (R25 (3))
about.H3: R6 with R25: raised common scale, odd edits, test rows of the near-scope negatives; pair1 = rescope against the gate selected for H3, pair2_x = rescope_x against its _x form, retr = rescope against the retrieval reference in the form of pair 1; a draw on which the raise is unreachable counts 0 for that method
about.status: replication read-outs on unseen logs (not the confirmatory family of R6); the Holm correction over the unseen logs of both backbones is in x_release/out/holm.json
